programme.title: Vera
programme.desc: Divdesmit sešus gadus vecā kriminālistikas psiholoģe Džoana tiek atrasta mirusi. Redzētais pamatīgi šokē jauno un iedomīgo psihologu Malkolmu, kurš sācis strādāt tikai nesen. Nevienam nerodas pat mazākās idejas par slepkavības motīviem. Vera atklāj, ka Džoana pieprasījusi lietas materiālus par kādu nesen atbrīvotu cietumnieku. Arī Metjū, Džoanas mentors, nav bez vainas brīdī, kad pieņem nepareizus lēmumus cietumnieka lietas izmeklēšanā. Aizdomās turamo skaits pieaug arvien vairāk pēc tam, kad atklājas strīdi starp Džoanu un viņas draudzeni.

programme.title: Vera
programme.desc: Drosmīga un patiesa. Godīga un pašironiska. Apveltīta ar iekšējiem dēmoniem un smalku prātu. Inspektore Vera atgriežas noziegumu izmeklēšanas laukumos jau devīto sezonu pēc kārtas. Katrā no izmeklēšanas lietām Vera atrod un ierauga ko tādu, kas paslīd nemanīts citu acīm. Veras lomu atveido aktrise Brenda Bletina, kas ir vairākkārt nominēta Oskaram, tā skaitā par lomu Maika Lī filmā "Noslēpumi un meli", par kuru arī ieguvusi "Zelta Globusu". Sērijas balstītas uz rakstnieces Annas Klīvsas grāmatas "Veras Stenhoupas noslēpumi" motīviem.

programme.title: Pirmās lēdijas
programme.desc: Būdams Kenedija viceprezidents, Lindons Džonsons stājās prezidenta amatā, kad tika veikts atentāts pret Džonu Kenediju. Iespējams, Leidibērda bija vissmagāk strādājošā pirmā lēdija. Politiskās karjeras veidošanas ziņā viņi bija vienlīdzīgi. Tā kļuva arī par viņas karjeru. Viņa mēdza teikt, ka tā ir viņu prezidentūra.

programme.title: Markoviča metode
programme.desc: Seriāla darbība notiek Čehoslovākijā 70. un 80. gados. Ir noticis smags noziegums - izvarošana un slepkavība ar sadistiskām pazīmēm. Izmeklēšana tiek uzticēta Jiržīja Markoviča grupai. Kad aizdomās turamais tiek aizturēts, Markovičs nesteidz nodot lietu, bet sāk ar viņu sarunāties, cenšoties izprast slepkavas domāšanu. Katrā sērijā paralēli galvenajai izmeklēšanai tiek atspoguļots vēl kāds noziegums. Seriāla pamatā ir patiesi notikumi.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Sebastjēns Leklērs atrod savu dēlu Ksavjē nodurtu. Komanda sāk izmeklēt lietu. Uz Bruno mašīnas tiek uzlīmēta uzlīme ar norādi, ka automašīnā ir bērns, protams, pirmā aizdomās turamā ir Nansija Riopela. Daniels brīdina Patriku un Noeliju, ka viņu attiecības var ietekmēt viņu darbu.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Turpinās Ksavjē slepkavības lietas izmeklēšana, vēl nav rasta atbilde uz jautājumu, vai slepkavība saistīta ar nepilngadīgo pornogrāfijas lietu. Viržīnija videozvanā Patrikam atklāj, ka Lorāna vīri viņu meklē un ir izvandījuši viņas dzīvokli. Nansija turpina satraukt savu māsu ar savu dīvaino rīcību.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Iecirknī ierodas Ksavjē tēvs. Paralēli skatītājs iepazīstas ar Mateo dzīvi un… atzīšanos. Tikmēr Bruno nespēj rast mieru no Nansijas, kura joprojām apgalvo, ka ir stāvoklī no viņa. Iecirknis saņem neparastu zvanu un turpina Ksavjē slepkavības izmeklēšanu.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Floransa uzklausa kādu sievieti, kurai šķiet, ka viņas kaimiņiene ir nozagusi svešu bērnu. Izrādās, ka no Noelijas datora nopludināta svarīga informācija, līdz ar to viņa tiek apsūdzēta informācijas nodošanā Nikam Romano un tālāk - Džo Bokasini.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Seriāls "Policijas iecirknis 31" seko stāstam par detektīvseržanti Nadīnu Legrānu un viņas kolēģi Patriku Bisonē, kā arī citiem viņu biedriem policijas iecirknī, kur viņi sastopas ar ikdienas noziegumiem, kas notiek lielajās pilsētās: slepkavības, nolaupīšanas, ielaušanās, vardarbība ģimenē, narkotiku tirdzniecība, terorisms un daudz kas cits.

programme.title: V.I.P. - Veiksme. Intuīcija. Prāts
programme.desc: Kļūsti par TV spēles V.I.P. — Veiksme. Intuīcija. Prāts. — satura veidotāju, iesniedzot savu jautājumu. Vēlamies vairāk iesaistīt skatītājus, vairot interesi par erudīciju, lai skatītāji paši kļūtu par aizraujošu, interesantu jautājumu veidotājiem. Kas jādara? Aizpildi jautājumu anketu V.I.P. sadaļā un iegūsti vērtīgas grāmatas vai naudas balvu!

programme.title: Latvijas Sirdsdziesma
programme.desc: Latvijas Sirdsdziesma ir sirsnīgi muzikāls raidījums, kurā tiek atspoguļotas tautā vispopulārākās latviešu mūzikas dzīves norises šī vārda visplašākajā nozīmē.

programme.title: Aizliegtais paņēmiens
programme.desc: Lai uzzinātu par kāda notikuma patiesajiem apstākļiem vai iesaistīto personu nodomiem, raidījuma "Aizliegtais paņēmiens" komanda informācijas iegūšanai izmanto visdažādākos izmeklējošās žurnālistikas paņēmienus un žanrus – eksperimentus, testus, provokācijas, padziļinātus pētījumus, arī anonīmas intervijas. Žurnālisti padziļināti pēta un skatītājiem atklāj sociālpolitiskus tematus, kas ne vienmēr tiek izcelti citos medijos. Raidījums atklāj un atmasko, atsevišķos gadījumos sauc pie atbildības iesaistītās personas, norāda uz likumu nepilnībām, aicina mainīt pastāvošo kārtību, ja tā ir pretrunā sabiedrības interesēm. Raidījumu vada LTV Ziņu dienesta žurnālists Guntis Bojārs.

programme.title: Sporta studija
programme.desc: "Mūsu uzņemtais virziens izsakāms neformālā sauklī "sports sabiedrībai!". Šis virziens tika uzsākts jau iepriekš ar "Tautas sporta" sižetu sērijām un sporta laukumu kampaņām. Turpmāk LTV Tautas sporta sižeti būs tradicionāla "Sporta studijas" sastāvdaļa. "Sporta Studiju" vadīs rūdītie sporta žurnālisti Dāvids Ernštreits un Reinis Ošenieks, kā arī jaunās sporta žurnālistikas zvaigznes Andris Auziņš, Matīss Timofejevs un Raimonds Gekišs. programme.title: Superskilled with Eva Zu Beck
programme.desc: Explorer Eva zu Beck travels to Iten, Kenya - the legendary "Home of Champions" known for producing the fastest long-distance runners in history - for an intense, one-week running training camp. Watch as she immerses herself in the Kenyan running culture to learn the secrets of elite marathon runners and world champion athletes in this high-altitude training mecca. With a Kenyan Olympian as a coach, Eva sets out on her mission to become a faster runner and significantly improve her marathon time through training techniques, a specialized running diet, daily schedule, and powerful mindset that separates the best from the rest.

programme.title: Superskilled with Eva Zu Beck
programme.desc: Eva zu Beck travels to the Amazon to meet members of the Yukuna Indigenous community in Leticia, Colombia. Traditionally, the culture still practices plant-based medicine and many protective and healing rituals, some involving pain as a way to increase resilience. Her guide is Fermín, a shaman who is a respected expert in Yukuna culture. His welcome immediately tests her ability to endure some discomfort. This would only serve as a small glimpse into the pain ritual Eva came to experience with a species native to the Amazon: the bullet ant. Throughout the experience, she second-guesses her decision to be bitten by a handful of bullet ants. She channels the Yukuna culture while attempting to manage a pain like she's never experienced before.

programme.title: Pole to Pole with Will Smith
programme.desc: Will, Bryan and Carla join local Waorani elder Penti Baihua in the Amazon, in search of the world's biggest snake: the giant green anaconda. They carefully remove just one scale from the 17-foot snake's skin. Will's fear turns into relief, then joy. The single scale can reveal the health of the entire ecosystem — crucial for the future of both wildlife and the Waorani.

programme.title: Underworld, Inc.
programme.desc: For migrants crossing illegally from Mexico to the United States, surviving in the desert alone can be a brutal experience. But add to that threats from people traffickers, many of whom are affiliated with cartels, and immigrants can face extortion, miserable conditions at "stash houses" and sometimes even being forced into prostitution. Once in the traffickers clutches, migrants become a sort of human cargo, treated as nothing but business assets to the ruthless organized criminals holding them hostage. This story is told from the inside, in the words of the migrants and from the mouths of the people smuggling foot soldiers.

programme.title: Underworld, Inc.
programme.desc: From the illegal weapons to the underground sex trade, nothing is off limits and everything is for sale in illegal, underground markets. It's an industry that is brutal, exploitative, and corrupt where what you buy isn't always what it seems. Despite efforts to crack down on these illegal trades, more than $625 billion makes it's way into the US economy each year for illegal trade goods. Unprecedented inside access brings light to the inner workings of the last bastion of 'free' enterprise, charting a global path to the underworld economy. Workers, suppliers, sellers, customers – and the law enforcement trying to keep it in check - share their experience of a hidden world that touches us all.

programme.title: Underworld, Inc.
programme.desc: Millions of Americans love to gamble. But some forms of gambling are restricted or illegal, pushing them underground, where the rules are very different. Here if you want to play you have to pay. The bookie will extend credit, but "miss a week, you miss a finger." Or worse. In the shadows of the law, people will bet on anything; legal or illegal. Innocent lives are put at risk in a world where only one thing matters: money.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
programme.desc: Gordon explores Oaxaca, a Mexican city steeped in history and tradition, on a mission to unlock the secrets of the region's famous cuisine. Gordon scales cliffs on the hunt for edible insects, chops down agave in the sweltering heat and learns how to make mole with a master. After a week of adventures, Gordon goes head to head with one of Mexico's top-rated chefs, Gabriela Cámara, to put his newfound skills to the test.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsey sets out on a journey to some of the worlds most remote locations, where he'll be looking for an adventure of the culinary kind. Basking in the culture of each setting he ends up, his cooking has never been more inspired than when on such an adventure. Whether he's cooking at altitude in Peru or educating himself on Alaskan cuisine, Gordon is experiencing the world like never before and beautifully curating a delicious morsel for each setting. It's a far cry from the professional kitchen he's used to and he's handling ingredients that are completely new, but the food doesn't get better than this.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: Port Protection is home to the few who have left behind normal society and chosen a different life in a remote Alaskan community, where survival of the individuals and community cannot sustain without the other. The stakes are high. The land is rugged and unforgiving and the seas which surround Port Protection are cold and merciless. With risk comes a reward more profound than mere survival: a world of beauty and freedom with the security of community and without the constraints of bureaucracy. In Port Protection there are no clear roads to survival, inhabitants must carve one themselves.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: The residences come together, combining old wisdom with youthful strength to ensure the future of Port Protection. Sam, Carl and Troy build a vital log hauler for their future homesteads. Curly is hungry for some heart and liver, so he hunts the rainforest for a young buck. Squibb and Chris build a significant upgrade to their infrastructure. Oliver and Breanna continue on their quest to harvest a bear.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz are off to Dorset to pick up a Ford Escort MK2 RS2000. The car belongs to self-employed carpenter Mike. After his son was involved in an horrific road accident Mike gave up work and supported him through a four year recovery. Now Mike's family want to give something back to say thank you to this devoted father and what better thankyou than to present him with his fully restored RS 2000?

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Brand new: Tim Shaw and Fuzz Townshend are off to Loughborough to take on a 1992 Saab 900 Turbo that's in desperate need of repair. The car belongs to Saab enthusiast and former electrical engineer Pravesh. Sadly, due to ill health, Pravesh has been left with little strength to work on the car, so it's been left to rot. His family believe getting his Saab back on the road would give him the boost he needs.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz head to Scotland to take on a 1993 Toyota Supra Mk.4 owned by former competitive motorcycle racer Lisa, who after a road accident is no longer able to ride her beloved bikes. Along came her Japanese supercar which helped fulfil her need for speed. Ongoing mobility problems have meant the car has ended in need of TLC. Lisa's friends and family hope a fully restored car will lift her spirits.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: Amsterdam is celebrating its 750th anniversary, and Amsterdam Central Station stands at the heart of the festivities. Alongside the city's milestone, station manager René marks 25 years of service. Ticket & Service employees Gusta and Alexandra join the anniversary celebrations, while keeping a close eye on autumn showers drifting toward the station. With record crowds pouring in for the historic year, kiosk employee Rosa anxiously awaits a delivery as warehouse worker Ron struggles to stay on schedule. Safety & Service officers Menno and Baran are deployed for the high-risk Ajax-Inter Milan match, where managing supporters proves demanding. And as a fierce autumn storm sweeps through the capital during this landmark celebration, track workers race against time to replace worn rails and keep the anniversary city moving.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: The Christmas holidays begin under extreme conditions as the heaviest snowstorm in 5 years slams into the region, bringing transport to a near standstill. At Central Station, the Christmas spirit descends as thousands of additional holiday passengers are expected despite the weather, turning an already busy period into a logistical battle. Inside the control room, Code Orange is declared as delays cascade across the network. A stalled train compounds the disruption, while platforms grow crowded. Assistant station manager Michel coordinates Christmas decorations while Ticket & Service staff Alexandra and Gusta help create a festive atmosphere. Meanwhile, Safety & Service officers Menno and Baran respond to one incident after another. With snow piling up and pressure mounting, everybody must work together to prevent total gridlock.

programme.title: Top Guns: The Next Generation
programme.desc: The students face their final test in an iconic head-to-head dogfight against their instructors. To pass, they must bring all the skills they have learned during their advanced phase training. With graduation just days away, students start to worry about their final grades and whether they will get the posting they—and in many cases, their families—want.

programme.title: Top Guns: The Next Generation
programme.desc: In the high-octane competitive world of the U.S. Navy's toughest fighter pilot school, only the strong succeed. This world exclusive takes the viewer inside the final grueling six months of training and selection, where the students learn how to fly combat missions. Dreams of earning strike pilot wings collide with the harsh reality of the most rigorous tests yet. We are inside the cockpit as they tackle adrenaline-fueled, dynamic aerial tests, each designed to push the students to their limits and beyond and not all will pass the test.

programme.title: Airport Security: Colombia
programme.desc: Security officials at El Dorado International Airport, in Bogota, Colombia, continue to foil the most audacious attempts at drug trafficking. On this new season of Airport Alert, they must detect sophisiticated new drug smuggling methods, arrest luggage thieves and detain suspects with international arrest warrants, while also dealing with medical emergencies, document forgery and cases of identity theft. Ranked as one of the 23 best airpots in the world, El Dorado is one of the biggest and most dynamic air terminals in Latin America. The airport serves 25 million passengers and handles 200,000 tons of cargo every year in its 1,100-hectare facility. Things are moving day and night, and appearances can be deceiving. Airport Alert follows agents 24/7 and captures their efforts to ensure the security of passengers and cargo alike.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report

programme.title: Engineering by Catastrophe
programme.desc: Every year, flood risks increase. Across the globe, big cities are experiencing giant storm surges and extreme rainfall, overwhelming natural waterways and drainage systems, catastrophes that rewrite the rules for engineers. In Tokyo, a city already prone to natural disasters, giant rivers are being built underground to cope with raging torrents and typhoons. In Spain, the horror of the Valencia floods has taught authorities the importance of early warning systems when infrastructure fails. In New Orleans, the Army Corps has revolutionized storm surge barriers — but it took the worst flood tragedy in US history to rewrite the future.

programme.title: Engineering by Catastrophe
programme.desc: When the Morandi Bridge collapsed in Genova in 2018, it was more than a national tragedy. Its failure was a reckoning for engineers everywhere and a sobering reminder that every structure has a lifespan. In a world of increasing populations, changing traffic volumes and extreme weather events, how can we safeguard new bridges? Engineers for Genova's new bridge met the challenge, focusing on intelligent safety and advanced robotics. As Turkey builds the longest suspension bridge in the world, engineers push the limits with clever innovations, delivering a modern marvel that withstands wild winds, catastrophic ship collisions and Earth's seismic fury.

programme.title: Voyagers: Exploring Pacific Waters
programme.desc: 4000 years ago, in hand-built canoes, people dare to venture into the unexplored Pacific Ocean, searching for islands to start new lives on. Over countless generations they voyage from Taiwan to Vanuatu and beyond. Guided by the sea, stars and the stories of their ancestors, they become master navigators, and unlock a sea of islands. But ocean exploration brings great risks. To overcome merciless natural barriers, these voyagers must deeply understand the brutally powerful Pacific. They build homes on thousands of islands, developing rich cultures filled with song, dance and legends of the sea. But after discovering Fiji, Samoa and Tonga, they find no more islands. Their ocean world remains connected by their canoes, and for 1000 years voyagers sail into unknown, perilous waters, hoping that one day the sea will lead them to new lands.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece
programme.desc: International teams of archaeologists investigate the truth behind the legends of Hercules. Excavators at Olympia uncover a colossal wall that may shed light on the hero's 12 labors. At Gibraltar, investigators explore a mysterious cavern beneath one of the so-called Pillars of Hercules.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece
programme.desc: International teams of archaeologists investigate the legacy of one of history's most famous figures: Alexander the Great. New discoveries reveal the architectural wonders of Pella in Greece and Ephesus in Turkey; and in Egypt, archaeologists also uncover a skeleton with terrible injuries. Could it hint at the dark side of this golden age?

programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
programme.desc: Executed on charges of adultery and treason, Anne Boleyn is often remembered as the "harlot" who seduced Henry VIII into annulling his first marriage and forcing his country into religious turmoil. By examining what really led to her execution in 1536, Professor Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow reveal a far more complex reality. They discover Anne's appeal to the king was as much intellectual as physical. No mere social climber, she was a moral reformer who sought to use her royal influence for public good. But Anne's power evaporated as her relationship with chief minister Thomas Cromwell fractured and her pregnancies failed to deliver the male heir Henry demanded. Suzannah and Dan uncover evidence that the stunning charges against Anne were falsified; was she actually innocent? This is the story of England's most misunderstood queen.

programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
programme.desc: In 1588, Robert Devereux, the Earl of Essex stood beside Elizabeth I as she rallied her troops to face the Spanish Armada. Young and charismatic, he was Elizabeth's intimate confidante, her favourite. But Essex's charm was matched by his recklessness. From arguing with the queen to leading a disastrous military campaign in Ireland, his behaviour pushed the limits of royal patience. Eventually, disgruntled and politically weakened, Essex launched a rebellion that would see him executed. Was he really out to seize the crown? Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow trace the volatile relationship between queen and favourite. Examining centuries-old documents, they uncover evidence-tampering and the devious tactics of an arch-rival, revealing that Essex was undone not only by his own ambition and hotheadedness, but also by ruthless court politics.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Chemicals. Garbage. Fish. A trucker needing a rescue isn't concerned about just his rig. The truck's cargo is another big worry. Stig is sent to rescue an animal transport carrying live pigs that got stuck in a ditch, Thord heads out to rescue a truck carrying hot asphalt that tipped when it moved over for oncoming traffic, on another rescue Thord races against time to rescue a truck carrying thousands of euros worth of fish.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler: Tropical Takedown
programme.desc: Homeland Security Investigations Puerto Rico arrest 37 members of a smuggling network responsible for multiple murders, and the import and export of cocaine on the island. Air and Marine operations agents in Mayagüez chase after a loaded vessel with $5.4 million in cocaine onboard. AMO agents in Fajardo investigate a party boat and discover a passenger on board entered the country illegally.

programme.title: Drugs Inc.
programme.desc: Molly, ecstasy rebranded as ultra-pure MDMA, is exploding as the new hot-selling drug. And with the growing popularity of electronic dance music, molly use has skyrocketed, overwhelming supply and driving prices to astronomical levels. National Geographic Channel brings you new-wave dealers who have found a solution to the exhausted supply in the form of a molly alternative that is yielding much greater profits. Straying from the traditional criminal network, these dealers reveal how they have turned to international distributors, ordering their product online. See how Customs and Border Protection fights to disrupt trafficking, as chemical factories create new ways to avoid detection. NGC follows law enforcement as they hunt for MDMA labs to shut down these operations. Finding a new market as a street drug, NGC uncovers that the once-pure drug has transformed into a corrupt chemical with potentially catastrophic side effects.

programme.title: Drugs Inc.
programme.desc: This episode of Drugs Inc pushes series 6 into exciting new directions with a show based around one event; New Year's Eve in New York City. The biggest party of the year brings unique opportunities for dealers wishing to make a lot of money but they have a new set of problems to contend with; fierce competition with other dealers, stick up kids who make a living robbing them and the law enforcement who are on full alert to make sure the night goes without a hitch.

programme.title: Trafficked with Mariana van Zeller
programme.desc: Mariana van Zeller goes inside the secretive world of outlaw motorcycle gangs, also known as 1% clubs, when her interest is piqued by a string of biker-related violence. Undeterred by a strict code of silence, she interviews members of three major clubs, as well as ATF agents and cartel contacts, to learn about the bonds of blood and brotherhood that fuel these groups.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: The show that combines cold hard science with some of the craziest, most spectacular and painful user generated clips ever recorded is back for a third season. Richard Hammond introduces a host of new mishaps featuring brave, if misguided individuals from around the world and then explains the science behind their failure and humiliation with the use of bespoke animations and super slo-mo cinematography. Each week we show between 50 and 60 clips of misadventure - ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes. Each episode will feature several themes such as motorbike drifting, wakeboarding or attempting to fly drones. Clips are paused, re-wound, and re-played as we analyse exactly what went wrong and why. Richard Hammond explains the physics, chemistry and biology at play, by presenting forensic detail to explain the stupidity that resulted in failure. He'll study everything from acceleration to aero dynamics, fluid pressure to combustion and human anatomy to flammability. This is misadventure explained. This is The Science of Stupid.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: Port Protection is home to the few who have left behind normal society and chosen a different life in a remote Alaskan community, where survival of the individuals and community cannot sustain without the other. The stakes are high. The land is rugged and unforgiving and the seas which surround Port Protection are cold and merciless. With risk comes a reward more profound than mere survival: a world of beauty and freedom with the security of community and without the constraints of bureaucracy. In Port Protection there are no clear roads to survival, inhabitants must carve one themselves.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: The volatile climate of Southeast Alaska challenges Port Protection's residents who live on the edge of society. Gary battles father time while securing needed resources. Curly pushes through in the wake of a tragic loss. Mary faces her fears to survive in extreme conditions. Sam fights to preserve the only lifestyle he's ever known. Squibb looks to improve upon his surroundings. And Stuart deals with past injuries as he battles the elements.

programme.title: Drain the Oceans: Deep Dive
programme.desc: Lost civilizations, mysterious sunken cities and the legendary sites have all vanished beneath the waves. Can draining the seas help unlock their secrets? Through the use of cutting edge new technology we will reveal part of these lost worlds for the first time. With the help of science and the worlds top marine archaeologist we will showcase the powerful natural forces that led to these cities demise.

programme.title: Drain the Oceans: Deep Dive
programme.desc: For centuries treasure ships sailed the oceans of the world...packed with silver, gold and precious stones. Hunted by pirates. Battered by storms. Threatened by reefs and rocky shores. Around the world, countless treasures and wrecks remain unexplored. Now, new underwater scientific surveys explore the deep oceans, powerful computers turn data in to 3D images, and we can examine sunken treasures in detail from any angle. Draining the oceans throws new light on the richest wrecks in the world.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: The Infinite Explorer with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Hannah Fry journeys across islands, mountains and olive groves to reveal why ancient Greece was the birthplace of so many big ideas. From sailing old trade routes through the Aegean to marvelling at the optical illusions hidden in the Parthenon, she explores how ideas were shaped by the dramatic landscape and how a mastery of maths, architecture and navigation fuelled a golden age of progress and innovation. Exploring the threads between ancient and modern Greece, she joins a family of olive farmers in Crete preserving centuries-old traditions, and visits the mountaintop monasteries in Meteora, where nuns safeguard classical texts. In the coastal town of Galaxidi, she's swept up in a riotous flour-throwing festival that blends ancient myth with modern identity.

programme.title: The Infinite Explorer with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Hannah Fry travels to Vietnam, a land of staggering natural beauty, ancient traditions and some of the fastest growing skylines on earth. Over 1,600 km from the vibrant South to the historic North, she uncovers the story of the country's remarkable post-war transformation. She immerses herself in the moped chaos in Ho Chi Minh City, helps with a muddy prawn harvest in the Mekong Delta and takes a restorative spa bath in the misty hilltops of Sapa. She ushers in the New Year with a local family celebrating the Tet festival and learns how a beloved dish, pho, tells a story of identity. In each place she visits, she meets characters whose lives have been shaped by both war and renewal. What emerges is a nation embracing change, where striking contrasts are balanced by a spirit of cooperation and strong family bonds.

programme.title: Superstorm New York: What Really Happened
programme.desc: Experts investigate the cause behind the storm that ravaged New York, as well as scrutinise the US government's response plans.

programme.title: Tsunami: Race Against Time
programme.desc: A massive earthquake in the Indian Ocean sets off a tsunami that, within minutes, arrives in the bustling city of Aceh, causing unprecedented havoc and devastation. This film follows the desperate struggle to survive of city-dwellers in Indonesia and tourists in Thailand caught in the unfolding catastrophe, as well as the scientists working against the clock to warn the world.

programme.title: Chernobyl: Inside the Meltdown
programme.desc: At 1.23AM on April 26th,1986 a massive explosion rips through reactor number four at Chernobyl nuclear power plant in the Soviet Ukraine. A safety test has triggered the worst nuclear accident in history, releasing 400 times more radiation into the atmosphere than the Hiroshima bomb. While control room operators reel in shock, the nuclear plant's firefighters battle the blaze amidst lethal levels of radiation. Just 3km away in the local town of Pripyat, Communist party officials encourage life to go on as normal. Children go to school and couples get married while radiation rains down on them. Meanwhile a giant radioactive cloud starts to circle the globe. Episode 1 follows the first 24-hours of the disaster, with first-hand accounts from people desperately trying to make sense of an accident no one thought could ever happen.

programme.title: Hurricane Katrina: Race Against Time
programme.desc: It's a typically vibrant New Orleans summer when Hurricane Katrina looms. Sitting in the bullseye of a Category 5, the city faces a reality check. With a delayed evacuation order, many are trapped and forced to brace for the storm's fury. Residents recount for the first time how they navigated the impending disaster, capturing the harrowing experience of preparing for "The Big One."

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Super Scam Me
programme.desc: Romance scammers stole more than $1 billion from American victims in 2025, and award-winning journalist Mariana van Zeller wants to know how they do it. She is going undercover to become the target of a romance scam. Only by intentionally falling prey to these criminal operators can she fully expose the tactics, technologies and psychology that have made these scams not just common but inescapable. Ultimately, she wants to meet her scammer face-to-face in a journey that will become very real as she uncovers his real name and identity and tracks him to his home in West Africa.

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: The shroud of Turin is one of the most debated archaeological artifacts in the world. Is it the burial cloth of the Christian messiah, Jesus of Nazareth, or is it an elaborate fake? Every time the evidence points one way or another, a credible counter argument is raised. In the collective imagination of the mid-20th century, jetpacks were the personalized transportation of the future. American engineer Wendell Moore really did develop and test a model for the military, so why don't we all have one? Buried for 2,400 years, a pair of beautiful cups are discovered in a grave mound made by Scythians, an ancient civilization of the Caucasus Mountains. What can the cups be for if they have holes in the bottom? And why are they solid gold?

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: Outside Draskow, Poland, an undocumented cemetery hundreds of years old is found in 2010 containing a woman's skeleton with a blade on her stomach, a stone on her neck and a green color in her mouth. Was this strange burial a precaution against the living dead? During the cold war, the United States developed a surveillance tool that was the first of its kind—code name: Project Corona. Did the shiny golden dome really help avert nuclear Armageddon? Countless literati have studied Shakespeare's plays for his profound prose, but what about for secret-coded messages? In the 1800s, Dr. Orville Ward Owen built a hulking wooden machine to do just that and concluded that Shakespeare was not who we think. Does his theory stand up to scrutiny?

programme.title: Paranatural
programme.desc: From Loch Ness to the west coast of Canada, people are reporting sightings of sea creatures they can't explain. Witnesses swear they've spotted creatures with flippers, long necks and horselike heads. Are they seeing remnants from the dinosaurs or mythical beings or just mistaking ordinary creatures for something Paranatural?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Just minutes after taking off from Lima, the crew of Aeroperú Flight 603 is overwhelmed by a series of conflicting error messages. Flying blind through thick clouds—and unable to confirm either airspeed or altitude—the pilots don't know which alarm they can trust. A controller steps in and dispatches a rescue plane to guide them back to the airport, but help doesn't arrive in time. And just as the crew is troubleshooting over open ocean, the Boeing 757 plunges into the Pacific, instantly killing everyone on board. A Navy expedition to the sea floor proves the plane was intact when it hit the water and successfully retrieves the plane's black boxes. A single image of the wreckage reveals a minor maintenance glitch with deadly repercussions, while the flight data reveals the crew was ill-prepared for a fatal cascade of erroneous data.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Moments after taking off from a windswept Norwegian island, the pilots of Widerøe Flight 839 hear a disturbing noise and then struggle to keep their plane level. And—after only 65 seconds in the air—their twin turboprop nosedives into the North Atlantic, killing everyone on board. In the wreckage, investigators discover damage to a critical steering component. And when they learn that another Widerøe flight nearly met the same fate at Værøy's notoriously tricky airport, they diagnose a perfect storm of controversial decisions that put lives at ris

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Repatriating Indian nationals from Dubai in the midst of the COVID-19 epidemic, Air India Express Flight 1344 is on final approach to Calicut airport amid heavy showers, reduced visibility, and strong winds. The treacherous tabletop runway leaves no margin for error. And after a first missed attempt, the Boeing 737-800 touches down—yet fails to stop—and plunges into a gorge. The aircraft breaks apart on impact, killing 21 people, including the two pilots. At first, investigators suspect a problem with the braking system. But they soon discover a shocking malfunction of an entirely different nature. For some reason, the aircraft came in above the glide slope, flew well past the touchdown zone, and ran out of runway. And the fatal cause is logged on the cockpit voice recorder.

He slowly grows braver until a solo adventure brings him face to face with the pride's mortal enemy: the buffalo.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Built to Survive

programme.title: Africa's River Titans
programme.desc: Africa is a land of giants. Its mighty rivers sculpt the earth and form impressive valleys and waterways home to many imposing and powerful inhabitants. These are the rivers where massive elephants and hippos live, feed and drink and where ancient crocodiles hunt and breed. They share the rivers with other creatures of their kind, such as porcupines - the giant rodents in Africa, the martial eagle - the biggest of its kind on the continent, and the leopard - a giant among the spotted cats

programme.title: Africa's Ghost River
programme.desc: Each year, the waters of the Okavango River arrive at the Kalahari in the dead of winter, transforming the sand into Eden.

programme.title: Africa's Ghost River
programme.desc: The Boteti River is a vital, dry-season pitstop for the tens of thousands of animals that rely on its water during the annual migration.

programme.title: Africa's Ghost River
programme.desc: Death in the Dust. At the end of the Ghost River lies an ancient salt pan. Instinct drives thousands of animals from across the Kalahari to converge here, seeking refuge in one of Africa's greatest gambles.

programme.title: Crocodile - Australia's Greatest Survivor
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. In Australia, dominant saltwater crocodiles, called 'boss crocs', are the largest and most powerful animals on the continent. Even after unrelenting human pressure on their very survival, they are still the masters of their world.

programme.title: Wild Florida
programme.desc: The coral islands, lush mangroves and sandy beaches of the Florida coastline may seem idyllic. But for its wild inhabitants coping with continued development and human encroachment, plus a host of natural predators, the edge of the sea is a paradise filled with peril. Bordered between seashore and suburbia, legions of Loggerhead turtle hatchlings begin their epic journey from sandy shores to the depths of the open ocean. If they are to return to their natal beaches as adults, they must survive a gauntlet of predators including sharks and invasive lionfish stalking the reefs. The American crocodile patrols the brackish waters, always looking for an ambush to satisfy his appetite. But in this difficult hunting season, the croc will struggle to find food. Life on Florida's deadly coast is no day at the beach

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabls un suņi atrod vectēva Grants laimīgi boulinga bumbu. Diemžēl Celtnieklīcī nav boulinga zāles... līdz šim! Kad pēkšņa superziedēšana sagūsta Motori, Liliju un Parka Reindžeri Rozu, suņiem jārod ziediem draudzīgs risinājums.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad Ātrmeistars sabotē Celtnieklīcības dienu, suņiem jāglābj svētki Celtnieklīcī. Miksa sapņo veikt mēness pārvērtības. Rabls un suņi piepilda viņas sapni ar jaunu raķeškuģa karuseli!

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Briežu komanda
programme.desc: Pūciņas kundze kopā ar Tēraudu apmeklē noslēpumainu salu, lai aplūkotu dāvanu no brālēna Aleksa. Mafins plāno panākt, ka Dinobots iekuļas nepatikšanās, bet viņa plāns neizdodas, jo abi kopā ar Lolu iestrēgst nekontrolējamā kosmosa kuģī.

programme.title: Blū pavedieni tev
programme.desc: Blū draudzene Fuksija šodien nāk ciemos! Mēs spēlējam Blū pavedienus, lai uzzinātu, ko Blū vēlas darīt kopā ar Fuksiju. Meklējot pavedienus, mēs salīdzinām pretstatus un pētām dzīvnieku ķepu nospiedumus kopā ar draugiem Lāpstu un Spainīti.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims, Tomijs, Tija un omīte ir dārgumu meklējumos. Ir Rūkoņas svētki, un Tims grib, lai viņa rūciens ir labākais. Tims, Tomijs un Tija savā mājā atrod pazudušu mamutu.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad Ātrmeistars uzbūvē atkritumu pārstrādes staciju pa savam, komandai jānovērš juceklis. Kad apmaldās pīlēns, Rabla komandai jārod risinājums, kā to vest mājās.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: Kapteinis Santjago, viņa varde Kiko, brālēns Tomass un nāra Lorelaja ir Enkanto salas pirāti-sargi. Ar sava burvju kuģa "El Bravo" un burvju rīku palīdzību Santjago vadīs savu drosmīgo komandu piedzīvojumos jūrā, lai pasargātu savu ģimeni un draugus. Taču kuģošana allaž nebūs mierīga, jo nāksies pārspēt viltībā negantus ļaundarus un negaidītus ienaidniekus.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Jauni piedzīvojumi ar DORU! Pievienojies drošajai pasaules pētītājai Dorai un viņas labākajam draugam Zābaciņam viņu kopīgajos ceļojumos pa maģisko lietusmežu, kurā var notikt - un notiek - brīnumu lietas. Let's go!

programme.title: Blū pavedieni tev
programme.desc: Blū draudzene Fuksija šodien nāk ciemos! Mēs spēlējam Blū pavedienus, lai uzzinātu, ko Blū vēlas darīt kopā ar Fuksiju. Meklējot pavedienus, mēs salīdzinām pretstatus un pētām dzīvnieku ķepu nospiedumus kopā ar draugiem Lāpstu un Spainīti.

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Krokodilkungs uztver teicienu "Kas atrod, tas patur!" burtiski. Kad Deizija un Krokodilkungs atrod Floresas kundzes vecās deju kurpes, viņi sarīko viņai deju šovu.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Slēpošanas laikā Barbapapas uzceļ milzīgu iglū. Barbabravo and Barbalibs sacenšas drosmīgumā. Barbagudrais rada putekļu sūkšanas robotu, kas lieliski spēlē futbolu. Barbabērni sarīko spēli pret robotiem.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbagudrais pārklāj māju ar burvju produktu, lai novērstu ūdens sūci. Nākamajā dienā māja saplok kā balons. Putns uzvij ligzdu uz Barbazū vēdera. Barbazū grib kļūt par lieu koku, lai sniegtu patvērumu dzīvniekiem. Situācija kļūst sarežģīta.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims nolemj pierādīt, ka Kajas tētis ir kapteinis Dinostārs. Tims cenšas atpūsties, bet Tijai ir citi plāni. Tims nopērk labākos cepumus pilsētā, bet drīz saprot, ka citiem tos vajag vairāk nekā viņam.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims un Kaja meklē pludmalē apraktos niekus. Tims atbrīvojas no vecajām lietām, bet drīz saprot, ka ne visam vieta miskastē. Tims, Tija un Tomijs cenšas pārliecināt mammu un tēti par labu mīlulim.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Reksu ģimene dodas ceļojumā cauri galaktikai, lai nokļūtu Raķešpasaulē. Tims un Kaja cīnās par Terijas rezerves biļeti uz Kosmoslendu. Tims, Tija un Tomijs rīko talantu šovu, bet nevar izlemt, kurš uzstāsies pirmais.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Ātri jānomazgā Greitvejas dubļainais motocikls! Vīlers un suņi ķeras pie darba, lai uzbūvētu risinājumu pirms sacensībām. Vectēva Grants īpašā diena! Bet, kad nepieciešama suņu palīdzība, viņiem jāmaina vectēva dienas plāni.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Suņi uzzina, ka Celtne ir slepena skeitošanas zvaigzne! Bet, būvējot skeitparku, viņiem jārisina problēma ar cementa maisījumu. // Pilsētā ieradīsies Čārdžera mīļākā dziedātāja Sjerra Spīdošā... Ja suņi spēs uzbūvēt tuneli viņas turnejas autobusam!

Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Briežu komanda
programme.desc: Tērauds netīšam ar augšanas staru trāpa Stjū un Safijas kāmim, kas kļūst par milzīgu un biedējošu kāmi. Tērauds un Pūciņas kundze iesaistās tīrīšanas robotu sacensībās, kurās Kajs panāk, ka Botlers kļūst par tīrīgāko robotu pilsētā

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Jauni piedzīvojumi ar DORU! Pievienojies drošajai pasaules pētītājai Dorai un viņas labākajam draugam Zābaciņam viņu kopīgajos ceļojumos pa maģisko lietusmežu, kurā var notikt - un notiek - brīnumu lietas. Let's go!

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: Kapteinis Santjago, viņa varde Kiko, brālēns Tomass un nāra Lorelaja ir Enkanto salas pirāti-sargi. Ar sava burvju kuģa "El Bravo" un burvju rīku palīdzību Santjago vadīs savu drosmīgo komandu piedzīvojumos jūrā, lai pasargātu savu ģimeni un draugus. Taču kuģošana allaž nebūs mierīga, jo nāksies pārspēt viltībā negantus ļaundarus un negaidītus ienaidniekus.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims un Tija būvē laika mašīnu, lai nebūtu jāatklāj tētim patiesība. Tims dodas uz Dinostāra treniņu akadēmiju, bet ir neizpratnē par sava varoņa metodēm. Tēvocis Tibērijs apciemo Reksus, un Timam jāparāda, ka viņš māk uzvesties.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims, Tomijs un Tija savā mājā atrod pazudušu mamutu.

programme.title: Blū pavedieni tev
programme.desc: Ir Blū dzimšanas diena! Mēs spēlējam Blū pavedienus, lai uzzinātu, kādu dāvanu Blū vēlas saņemt dzimšanas dienā. Meklējot pavedienus, mēs palīdzam Džošam sagatavoties ballītei, vērojot notiekošo, un dodamies uz Džo dāvanu veikalu.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabo aizmirsa nodot bibliotēkas grāmatu. Bibliotekārs Misters Stingrais šodien ciemojas pie Barbatēta, tāpēc Barbabo izlemj aizbēgt. Barbamamma grib, lai barbabērni uzkopj savas istabas. Viņi slēpjas, lai izvairītos no garlaicīgā darba.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Slēpošanas laikā Barbapapas uzceļ milzīgu iglū. Barbabravo and Barbalibs sacenšas drosmīgumā. Barbagudrais rada putekļu sūkšanas robotu, kas lieliski spēlē futbolu. Barbabērni sarīko spēli pret robotiem.

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Džidžijai bija ļoti jautri ar savu draugu Ārtiju, kurš ciemojās, bet tagad viņam pienācis laiks doties mājās. Krokodila kungs un Deizija uztraucas, ka Džidžī būs vientuļa, kamēr Ārtija nebūs blakus. Draugi apņemas būt viņai blakus un nekad neļaut būt vienai. Bet visa šī uzmanība Džidžijai ir par daudz, un viņa cenšas atrast brīdi sev. Krokodila kungam un Deizijai ir jāiemācās, ka tas, ka kāds ir viens, nenozīmē, ka viņš ir vientuļš.

programme.title: Ķepaiņu lietas
programme.desc: Antropomorfisku dzīvnieku pasaulē Sems Snovs un Kita Keisija ir elitāri KLEID (Slepenā dzīvnieku detektīvu ekspertu līga) aģenti, kas apceļo pasauli un risina noslēpumus, liekot lietā problēmu risināšanas un dzīvnieku faktu pārzināšanas prasmes.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Pēc sniegota pārsteiguma pienākšanas, Rabla komanda piedāvā palīdzēt Hedlija viesnīcā. Kad kāpnes izrādās nepietiekami ātras, ir laiks celt. Karls adoptē kaķēnus. Kad viņi izraisa popkorna elli, Rabla komanda padara kafejnīcu kaķēniem draudzīgu.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Reindžere Roza lūdz Rabla komandu salabot Lāču salas tiltu. Kad remontdarbos iejaucas Ātrmeistars, ķepaiņiem jāsatīra viņa radītā nekārtība un jāpasargā lāčus no ātri tuvojošās vētras... ar tantes Celtnes jaunās Būvētavas Bultas palīdzību.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.desc: Barbagudrais pārklāj māju ar burvju produktu, lai novērstu ūdens sūci. Nākamajā dienā māja saplok kā balons. Putns uzvij ligzdu uz Barbazū vēdera. Barbazū grib kļūt par lieu koku, lai sniegtu patvērumu dzīvniekiem. Situācija kļūst sarežģīta.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbatētis un Barbamamma svin savas dzimšanas dienas. Barbabellai darba pilnas rokas, pieskatot pārējos. Barbabella pieskata Bali kaķēnus. Viņa baidās, kaut kas var noiet greizi, tāpēc nelaiž tos ārā. Barbamammai jāpalīdz kaķēniem.

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Martins ir uzbūvējis jaunu Bočes laukumu kopienai un rīko turnīru! Deizija un mamma apvienojas ar Krokodila kungu kā treneri, lai kopā pavadītu laiku kā māte ar meitu un krokodils. Taču, konkurencei kļūstot sīvākai, Deizija sāk uztraukties, ka, ja viņas neuzvarēs, viņa pievils mammu. Viņai jāatrod veids, kā nepievilt mammu, bet arī pateikt, kā viņa patiesībā jūtas.

programme.title: Ķepaiņu lietas
programme.desc: Antropomorfisku dzīvnieku pasaulē Sems Snovs un Kita Keisija ir elitāri KLEID (Slepenā dzīvnieku detektīvu ekspertu līga) aģenti, kas apceļo pasauli un risina noslēpumus, liekot lietā problēmu risināšanas un dzīvnieku faktu pārzināšanas prasmes.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Autokinoteātrī tiek izrādīta jauna Supervāveres filma. Kad Ātrmeistars sarīko kārtējo jezgu, ķepaiņiem jārīkojas, lai glābtu situāciju. Ir Tanšu diena! Vai ķepaiņi paspēs uzbūvēt dāvanu tantei Celtnei?

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabla komanda palīdz Riveram uzņemt daudz fotogrāfiju foto konkursam, uzbūvējot ļoti ātru veidu, kā pārvietoties pa Celtnieklīci. Rabls un ķepaiņi palīdz Karlam pagatavot saldējumu visiem. Ja vien Ātrmeistars viņiem netraucēs...

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: "Dullo vecāku" galvenais varonis ir desmit gadus vecs zēns Timijs, kurš dzīvo izdomātā pilsētā Dimsdeilā, un tur viņam neklājas viegli. Timija dzīve ir bēdīga, jo vecāki reti kad ir mājās, viņu pieskata Vikija, 16 gadus veca ļauna auklīte, viņš pastāvīgi tiek apsmiets, viņu moka arī skolotājs Krokera kungs. Bet viss mainās, kad viņam uzrodas divi laumiņu krustvecāki - Kosmo, viņa sieva Vanda un vēlāk - viņu dēls Pufs. Timijs apjauš, ka laumiņu krustvecāki noteiktās robežās spēj piepildīt visas viņa vēlēšanās. Tomēr Timijs vēl ir maziņš un reizēm ievēlas ko tādu, kas netīši noved pie nepatikšanām.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: Kapteinis Santjago, viņa varde Kiko, brālēns Tomass un nāra Lorelaja ir Enkanto salas pirāti-sargi. Ar sava burvju kuģa "El Bravo" un burvju rīku palīdzību Santjago vadīs savu drosmīgo komandu piedzīvojumos jūrā, lai pasargātu savu ģimeni un draugus. Taču kuģošana allaž nebūs mierīga, jo nāksies pārspēt viltībā negantus ļaundarus un negaidītus ienaidniekus.

programme.title: Blū pavedieni tev
programme.desc: Blū draudzene Fuksija šodien nāk ciemos! Mēs spēlējam Blū pavedienus, lai uzzinātu, ko Blū vēlas darīt kopā ar Fuksiju. Meklējot pavedienus, mēs salīdzinām pretstatus un pētām dzīvnieku ķepu nospiedumus kopā ar draugiem Lāpstu un Spainīti.

programme.title: Cūciņa Pepa
programme.desc: Cūciņa Pepa ir mīļa, ziņkārīga un aktīva pirmskolniece, kura kopā ar māmiņu, tēti un brālīti Džordžu ik dienu uzzina daudz ko jaunu un aizraujošu. Pepas iecienītākās nodarbes ir rotaļāšanās, pārģērbšanās un lēkāšana pa dubļainām peļķēm, un viņas jautrie piedzīvojumi vienmēr beidzas ar skaļiem smieklu rukšķiem.

programme.title: Cūciņa Pepa
programme.desc: Pepa un Džordžs palīdz mammai uzkopt pēc brokastīm. Mamma stāsta, ka pudeles jāliek zaļā tvertnē, lai tās pārstrādātu. Vecās avīzes liek sarkanajā kastē, bet bundžas - zilajā. Pepa un Džordžs ar prieku piepilda tvertnes.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Jauni piedzīvojumi ar DORU! Pievienojies drošajai pasaules pētītājai Dorai un viņas labākajam draugam Zābaciņam viņu kopīgajos ceļojumos pa maģisko lietusmežu, kurā var notikt - un notiek - brīnumu lietas. Let's go!

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Deizija un Krokodilkungs meklē veiksmes talismanu, kas palīdzēs laimēt velosipēdu. Deizija palīdz Krokodilkungam noskaidrot, kāpēc viņš nevar aizmigt, kad pirmoreiz nakšņo mājā.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbalala rīko lielo talantu konkursu. Katram barbabērnam uz skatuves jādemonstrē savs lielākais talants, nekādas nīkuļošanas! // Videospēles ir jautras, bet jāmāk izbaudīt jauki laikapstākļi. programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

programme.desc: Barbabravo nespēj nosēdēt mierā un ilgi koncentrēties vienai nodarbei. Barbalala piedāvā iemācīt viņam kontroli. Vai viņai izdosies?

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Rabla komanda

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbagudrais pārklāj māju ar burvju produktu, lai novērstu ūdens sūci. Nākamajā dienā māja saplok kā balons. Putns uzvij ligzdu uz Barbazū vēdera. Barbazū grib kļūt par lieu koku, lai sniegtu patvērumu dzīvniekiem. Situācija kļūst sarežģīta.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover
programme.desc: Max and Phoebe are clicking as a team, celebrating another big save, and impressing Captain Perfect with their work. However, they are unaware that the Mastermind's henchman Keifer has implanted a chip in Max's neck which makes him unwittingly commit crimes in Secret Shores. When President Kickbutt tells Phoebe and Captain Perfect what Max has been doing, she orders them to arrest him. Max escapes, and confronts Keifer about what she has been doing to him. Phoebe and Captain ultimately corner Max and remove the chip from his neck, but Max feels betrayed by his sister. Meanwhile, Chloe helps Jinx navigate a mess when he inadvertently invites both his mom and grandma to the dance as his dates.

programme.title: Danger Force
programme.desc: This fun spin-off of Henry Danger is set in the Swellview Academy for the Gifted and follows the adventures of four young friends. Chapa, Miles, Bose and Mika were ordinary kids, until they discovered they have superpowers. They are recruited by Captain Man to become his new crime-fighting crew, and protect the city of Swellview from various villains. But before that Captain Man must teach them how to control their superpowers, as well as to how to work as a team, using Schwoz as his helper.

programme.title: Henry Danger
programme.desc: Henry Danger is a story about adventures of a 13-year-old Henry Hart who is lucky to become a helpmate of a super hero Captain Man. This is a real dream job of every teen. The newbie is getting paid for fighting against crime and helping to save the world. Brave Henry must hide his job from his family and friends and it is not that simple, but nothing can stop him from being a true crime-fighter. Henry himself wants to become a super hero one day, that is why he is constantly learning from Captain Man and is not scared of any hardships on the way to his dream.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: Nine-year-old twins, Jade and Mica know Marsupilimis are real, as their explorer parents entrusted them with three precious eggs that hatched into Marsups named Hope, Twister, and Punch. They now live happily with the twins and their Gran Gran Suzanne above the family restaurant The Chahuta in Palombia, whilst the Twins parents search for the Marsups family. Living with three young Marsupilamis is an endless source of adventures. Jade and Mica love having having fun with them, but know, it's essential to keep their existence hidden from the outside world to keep them safe. Every day brings new challenges - taking the Marsupilamis to the park can quickly turn into a frantic race through the sewers and a confrontation with a wild jaguar, or a game of golf can result in capture by Stan the zoologist! Jade and Mica learn just as much from these fun furry creatures as the Marsupilamis learn from them - they make a great team and family!

programme.title: The Marsupilamis

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover
programme.desc: Phoebe and Max unwittingly let Chloe's friends watch a horror movie and eat candy, leaving them traumatized and craving more sugar. Jinx and Booch's parents want to meet with Chloe's parents to discuss the lack of supervision at the beach house. programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: Nine-year-old twins, Jade and Mica know Marsupilimis are real, as their explorer parents entrusted them with three precious eggs that hatched into Marsups named Hope, Twister, and Punch. They now live happily with the twins and their Gran Gran Suzanne above the family restaurant The Chahuta in Palombia, whilst the Twins parents search for the Marsups family. Living with three young Marsupilamis is an endless source of adventures. Jade and Mica love having having fun with them, but know, it's essential to keep their existence hidden from the outside world to keep them safe. Every day brings new challenges - taking the Marsupilamis to the park can quickly turn into a frantic race through the sewers and a confrontation with a wild jaguar, or a game of golf can result in capture by Stan the zoologist! Jade and Mica learn just as much from these fun furry creatures as the Marsupilamis learn from them - they make a great team and family!

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: iCarly is about teenager Carly who produces her own web show named iCarly along with her three friends Freddie, Sam and Gibby. The show is broadcasted from a studio Carly constructed in the flat where she lives with her 29 years old brother and guardian Spencer. While producing a webshow Carly is not looking for fame or fortune. Ideally she wants to be a role model for children and teenagers. iCarly ultimately features everything from comedy sketches and talent contests to interviews, recipes, and problem-solving.

programme.title: Victorious
programme.desc: Sitcom about a girl named Tori Vega and her life at an elite Hollywood performing arts high school. There is a lot of gossip about how Trina ever managed to get into Hollywood Arts. Robbie and Tori go out for a meal but he forgets his wallet, so they have to stay behind in the restaurant and chop squid to pay for their food.

programme.title: Sam & Cat
programme.desc: Prepare to meet the strangest match made in bestie heaven -- Sam & Cat! Sam's loud, independent, and tough as nails, while Cat is sweet as pie and super flighty. But that doesn't stop this unlikely pair from becoming best buds and roomies! Together, they're a power duo with a love for fun and adventure -- it's just too bad that it doesn't come cheap. A booming out-of-home babysitting business quickly becomes the answer to their empty-pocket problems, but also an extra reason for countless wacky adventures to come!

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.title: Wylde Pak

Struggling with a vacuum of power, Jack is chosen as their reluctant leader, but he's determined to usher them into peace. After being swallowed whole multiple times, Lily and Jack realize they must take a different approach, but then they hear horror stories from other townsfolk about their own run-ins with the giant fish proving that bagging the beast is an impossible task. Despite all this, Lily and Jack attempt to accomplish the impossible.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: Māksla dzīvot
programme.desc: Tiksimies ar uztura zinātnieku un mikrobioma pētnieku Ansi Gabrielu Zaueru. Skaidrosim, cik liels svars ir teicienam - tu esi tas, ko tu ēd. Tiksimies ar mākslas terapeiti Ilzi Dreifeldi, lai precīzāk izprastu šīs terapijas nozīmi cilvēka dzīvē. Un protams būs arī uzturs! Madara Meiere uz pusdienām aicinās geštaltterapeiti un attiecību speciālisti Annu Lieckalniņu. Abas dāmas ne tikai baudīs izcili veselīgo veģētāro maltīti, bet atklās attiecību noslēpumus sieviešu un vīriešu pasaulē.

programme.title: Latvijas stāsti
programme.desc: Alise Millere jau bērnībā sapratusi, ka nav meitene, kurai patīk kleitas un lūpu krāsas. Nogājusi garu un izaicinošu ceļu, smilteniete savu aicinājumu atradusi mēbeļu atjaunošanā. Gada sākumā piepildījies viens no Alises sapņiem - atvērta salondarbnīca, kur darboties pašai un uzņemt viesus un meistarklašu dalībniekus. Taču Alisei ir vēl kāds sapnis, kuru viņa nebaidās izpaust skaļi - kļūt par kādas Latvijas muižas saimnieci, kurā atgriet dzīvību gan ar cilvēku, gan atjaunoto mēbeļu palīdzību.
